text:
lena (product): FYI — MercuryPay asked for a compact SLA for dedicated bursts that focuses on fairness across simultaneous leases. Their main asks: per-route guarantees, predictable spill rules, and an explicit dispute reconciliation flow. Need minimal scope we can ship as a lean pilot.

omar (eng-platform): quick thought: instead of hard per-tenant pools we can implement a "lease weight" that the scheduler uses when computing fair-share. That lets multiple leases share one pool while honoring guarantees.

sunita (eng-sre): ops: fair-share with weights is doable but we must be crystal about eviction order when contention happens. Proposed spill rules: 1) satisfy guaranteed tokens per lease, 2) allow soft-band usage proportional to weight, 3) if overcommit, evict from the soft-band oldest-first, not by tenant. Also require preemption audit trail.

lena (product): good. MercuryPay explicitly wants a human-readable spill rule in the contract (so customers understand why their requests were deprioritized).

ravi (billing): For billing we need per-lease usage export (lease_id, route, tokens_guaranteed_used, tokens_soft_used, tokens_over). Also a reconciliation job that can mark disputed rows and produce an invoice adjustment. Suggest 72h dispute window.

felix (customer-success): MercuryPay will accept proportional soft-bands, but they want an option to buy a short "dominance window" (temporary higher weight for X minutes) leading into settlements. They asked what the UX will look like in onboarding.

omar (eng-platform): UX: a lease object with fields: routes[], guaranteed_tpm, weight, dominance_windows[]. dominance is just a higher weight for the window. Technical sketch:
```
lease_id: MP-2025-09-lease1
routes: ["/v1/settle", "/v1/pay"]
guaranteed_tpm: 90000
soft_band_ratio: 0.2  # 20% extra distributed by weight
weight: 50
dominance_windows:
  - start: 2025-09-18T01:00:00Z
    duration_minutes: 30
    temp_weight: 200
```

sunita (eng-sre): monitoring checklist: p50/p95 latency by route+lease, token_consumption (guaranteed vs soft vs over), eviction_events timeline, dominance_window_activations. Need a kill-switch for dominance windows in case of misconfig.

lena (product): contract language draft: "Spill rules: guaranteed tokens are honored first. Soft-band usage is allocated proportionally to active leases' weights. If capacity is exceeded, soft-band tokens will be reclaimed oldest-first from active soft usage. Customers may purchase dominance windows that temporarily increase a lease weight; dominance windows are billed separately and are subject to immediate revocation for emergency capacity events." Will iterate with legal.

ravi (billing): I'll add billing rows for dominance_windows (start, duration, billed_tokens, surcharge). Also will implement export schema and reconciliation flags.

omar (eng-platform): rough engineering estimate: scheduler changes to support weight-based soft-band allocation + dominance windows: 7 dev days. Telemetry + audit logs: 2 days. Billing export hooks + reconciliation: 3 days. UX/onboarding checkbox: 1 day. Total ~13 dev-days. Can be parallelized across two engineers.

sunita (eng-sre): ops: pilot gating checklist: 1) export present and validated, 2) eviction/audit logs verified with synthetic spikes, 3) dominance kill-switch tested, 4) reconciliation job ran end-to-end. Ops will need oncall cover for first 48hrs.

felix (customer-success): MercuryPay wants invoice preview during onboarding and a test-mode that simulates a dominance window. They'll run an internal legal review if we include audit export.

contract-bot: uploaded draft lease appendix (sensitive) to legal-review queue. :file_folder:

lena (product): action items: omar+sre to prototype weight-based allocator in sandbox this sprint, ravi to produce export schema + reconciliation spec, felix to collect exact dominance-window dimensions from MercuryPay. Decision checkpoint: next Tues EOD.

omar (eng-platform): noted. I'll start sandbox prototype and post results in the epic.

sunita (eng-sre): will script the synthetic spike tests and confirm eviction order determinism.

ravi (billing): will deliver schema by EOD tomorrow.

lena (product): thanks team  goal is to keep pilot minimal: 1 lease, 2 routes, one dominance window test, 30d logs retention in pilot. We'll expand after pilot validation. :rocket:
